name: @pipeworx/mcp-bioregistry

tools.name: prefix
tools.description: Fetch full Bioregistry metadata for a biological database prefix (e.g. "chebi", "hpo", "uniprot"), including canonical URI pattern, synonyms, homepage, and cross-registry mappings.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Bioregistry for biological database prefixes by substring match against prefix name, title, or description (e.g. "gene ontology"). Returns up to `limit` matching prefix records.

tools.name: resolve
tools.description: Resolve a CURIE (prefix:id) to a provider URL.

tools.name: prefixes
tools.description: Paginate over all registered Bioregistry prefixes (2,000+); returns full prefix records for each entry. Use limit/offset to page through the complete registry.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-bioregistry forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the bioregistry pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
